description: This is a Kotlin source file defining the `ContentInfoActivity` class for an Android TV application. The activity displays detailed content information, including metadata, background, system date/time, and focusable action buttons with navigation and animations. It also handles network requests to fetch and play media URLs.

classes.name: ContentInfoActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that displays detailed information about a content item with metadata, background, date/time, and action buttons. Supports network media playback and navigation.
